notes:
Account summary:
- Company: Vertexia builds an internal enterprise search layer for legal + corporate knowledge across 150M+ docs (mix: contracts, wikis, email archives).
- Current stack: custom Lucene + Pinecone for vectors, reranker is an in-house BERT pairwise model.
- Pain: cost at scale (vector storage + per-query reranker calls), inconsistent top-k quality when adding newer embeddings, slow tail latency during business hours.
- Project: Eval-driven migration of embeddings + reranker to reduce cost and improve top-k relevance. Must preserve or improve NDCG@10 (acceptable regression <= 1% absolute).
Technical requirements / targets:
- Indexing scale: ~150M documents initially; anticipate x2 in 18 months.
- Query throughput: steady 350 qps, peak 800 qps; target steady-state <150ms p95 for reranked response.
- Cost sensitivity: target reduce per-query cost by 30-50% vs current Pinecone+in-house reranker baseline.
- Model preferences: open-model embeddings; evaluate 3 candidate embed models + 2 rerankers (cross-encoder + lightweight transformer). Must support quantized variants for Dedicated/Private.
- Routing/fallback: prefer smart routing: cheap embedding + async heavier rerank only when confidence low. Need automatic fallback to a cached top-N.
- Security: VPC or on-prem preferred for PII; must have KMS integration and audit logs. Data residency required: US-only for legal docs.
Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-11-12 - Lead created in CRM (initial inbound via webinar).
- 2025-12-05 - Discovery call (Avery + Diego): confirmed indexing scale and QPS targets. Action: send cost calc template.
- 2026-01-18 - Security kickoff: shared security checklist; Vertexia requests on-prem feasibility. (linked doc).
- 2026-02-12 - Demo: Redwood hosted embeddings + small rerank POC. Fireflies: ff_20260212_17b3. AE notes: "embedding quality promising but reranker variance on legal clauses."
- 2026-03-03 - Eval planning call: agreed on A/B + canary rollout plan; Diego to deliver eval harness and sample prompts. Fireflies: ff_20260303_08a9.
- Internal: INF-4129 created to track compute sizing for dedicated pool.
ROI / buying signals:
- CTO (Jordan Black) quote: "We can tolerate minor latency increases if unit cost drops and relevance stays stable — but regressions hurt product adoption."
- Legal ops emphasized certification and residency; procurement set Q2 budget window.
Evaluation specifics requested by customer:
- Evals-driven migration: want Redwood Optimize to run embedding A/B across 10k seeded queries (legal queries) with automatic NDCG, MRR, per-query cost reports.
- Canary plan: 5% traffic for 7 days to new embed+rerkanker, gated by NDCG and latency thresholds. Must support rollback automation.
- Observability: token-level cost, per-route latency p50/p95/p99, top-k relevance snapshots, regression alerts tied to prompt sets.
Open questions / next actions:
- SE to provide sizing and cost model for Dedicated vs Private for 150M docs (due 2026-03-12) - delayed to 2026-03-16.
- Security team to confirm KMS/HSM integration steps and remote attestation for on-prem.
- Schedule 1-hour canary planning workshop (Avery + Diego + Priya + Vertexia infra) week of 2026-03-17.
- Customer blocker: procurement needs a clear SLA & rollback guarantees before legal signs off.
